normal.name: UndeadJamie
normal.text: Football Manager 27 releases (ish) today! I say ish because they're essentially letting anyone play the game for free for the first 5 days. After the shambles of last year's release being an unfinished mess, and the cancellation of the game the year before that, this feels like a great way to re-establish trust with FM players. From what I've seen, this new version actually looks like a finished game. I'm looking forward to playing it! #Gaming #FootballManager #FM27
